description: This file defines an interface for reading holiday-related data within the organisation module of the Fineract project. It declares methods for retrieving holiday data based on search parameters, specific holiday details, and options for repayment schedule updates.

classes.name: HolidayReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface for fetching holiday-related data, supporting search-based retrieval, specific holiday retrieval by ID, and fetching options for repayment schedule updates.

methods.name: retrieveAllHolidaysBySearchParamerters
methods.description: Retrieves all holidays matching specified search parameters such as office ID and date range.

methods.name: retrieveHoliday
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific holiday by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentScheduleUpdationTyeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of options related to repayment schedule updates.
